mock_data.title: Surprising News
mock_data.passage:
25/5/02

Dear Kay,

I am writing this in a hurry before I go to work. I just couldn't wait to tell you some amazing news. You'll never guess who've just got engaged! Rose Barnes and Mark Wilson! There, I bet that's surprised you!

We heard about it last night at Rose's birthday party. It was a fantastic party with lots to eat and drink and some great music. We were all having a brilliant time, when Mark suddenly got to his feet and started speaking. It took him a while to get everyone to stop talking and listen to him, but he announced that he had decided to make an honest woman of Rose and that he had popped the question the previous evening. He talked some more about how happy Rose had made him by agreeing to become his wife and waxed lyrical about how wonderful she is. By this time, hardly anyone was listening. Most of us were gobsmacked.

I didn't know that they were even friends, because I don't see either of them very often. Pam said that with the benefit of hindsight she should have realized that there was something going on between Rose and Mark, because they had seemed to be joined at the hip in recent weeks. However, they and Pam work in the same firm and she thought business was bringing them together a lot.

As you know, Rose and Mark are chalk and cheese and the idea of them tying the knot seems impossible. Besides, we all thought that Mark was a confirmed bachelor. Jill says that she is quite certain that it will all end in tears. Of course, she is a well-known cynic, but I think there is some truth in what she says. Apparently there are already signs of trouble. Rose wants a huge wedding with all the trimmings. Mark wants them to go abroad and get married quietly on a beach somewhere. Watch this space!

I'll have to go now or I'll be late for work. Write soon and let me know how you're getting on at college. I'm looking forward to Easter when you'll be home for the holidays and we can have a good chat.

Much love,
Jenny
mock_data.passageB1:
Dear Kay,

I’m writing this quickly before I go to work. I have some amazing news to tell you! You won’t believe who is getting married! Rose Barnes and Mark Wilson! I think that will surprise you!

We heard about it last night at Rose’s birthday party. It was a great party with lots of food, drinks, and good music. We were all having a good time when Mark stood up and started to talk. It took him a while to get everyone to stop talking and listen. Then, he said that he asked Rose to marry him. He said that Rose made him very happy by saying yes. He also said how wonderful she is. Most of us were very shocked.

I didn’t even know they were friends, because I don’t see them very often. Pam said that she now thinks she should have seen that something was happening between Rose and Mark. She said they were always together recently. But they and Pam work at the same company, so she thought it was because of work.

Rose and Mark are very different people, so it seems strange that they are getting married. Also, we all thought that Mark didn’t want to get married. Jill says that she thinks it will end badly. She is often negative, but I think she might be right. It seems like there are already problems. Rose wants a big wedding with everything. Mark wants to go to another country and get married quietly on a beach. We will have to wait and see!

I have to go now or I will be late for work. Write to me soon and tell me about college. I’m looking forward to Easter when you come home for the holidays and we can talk.

Much love,

Jenny
mock_data.passageB2:
Dear Kay,

I'm writing this in a rush before heading to work, but I just had to share some incredible news with you. You absolutely won't believe who's just gotten engaged! Rose Barnes and Mark Wilson! I bet that's a shock!

We found out last night at Rose's birthday party. It was a fantastic celebration with plenty of food, drinks, and great music. Everyone was having a wonderful time when Mark suddenly stood up and began to speak. It took him a while to get everyone's attention, but he finally announced that he had decided to settle down with Rose and that he'd asked her to marry him the night before. He went on about how happy Rose had made him by agreeing to be his wife and extolled her virtues. By that point, most people were completely taken aback.

I didn't even realize they were close friends, since I don't see either of them very often. Pam said that in retrospect, she should have noticed something was going on between Rose and Mark, because they had seemed inseparable lately. However, they work at the same company, and Pam assumed their shared projects were the reason for their increased contact.

As you know, Rose and Mark are complete opposites, and the thought of them getting married seems so unlikely. Besides, we all thought Mark was a confirmed bachelor. Jill is absolutely convinced that it will all end in disaster. Of course, she's a bit of a pessimist, but I think there might be some truth to what she says. Apparently, there are already early signs of conflict. Rose wants a huge wedding with all the bells and whistles. Mark wants them to go abroad and get married quietly on a beach. Time will tell!

I have to run now, or I'll be late for work. Write back soon and let me know how college is going. I'm looking forward to Easter when you'll be home for the holidays, and we can have a good catch-up.

Much love,

Jenny
mock_data.passageC1:
Dearest Kay,

Forgive the rushed nature of this missive, penned in haste before the exigencies of my workday beckon. I simply couldn't delay sharing some utterly astonishing news. Prepare yourself – you'll scarcely credit who's just become engaged! Rose Barnes and Mark Wilson! There, I wager that's taken you by surprise!

The revelation occurred last night at Rose's birthday celebration. It was a truly splendid affair, replete with copious food, drink, and excellent music. We were all thoroughly enjoying ourselves when Mark, apropos of nothing, rose to his feet and commenced speaking. He encountered some difficulty in quieting the assembled throng, but eventually announced his momentous decision to, as he put it, make an honest woman of Rose, revealing that he had popped the question the previous evening. He then proceeded to expound at length on the happiness Rose had brought him by accepting his proposal, lauding her virtues in what I felt was excessive detail. By this juncture, however, most of us were in a state of utter disbelief, completely flabbergasted by the announcement.

Prior to this, I hadn't even suspected a burgeoning connection between them, given my infrequent contact with either. Pam, however, claims that with the benefit of hindsight, she should have discerned the nascent romance, as Rose and Mark had apparently been inseparable in recent weeks. However, given their shared workplace, Pam had merely attributed their frequent interactions to professional obligations.

As you are well aware, Rose and Mark are diametrically opposed in terms of personality, and the prospect of their tying the knot seems almost inconceivable. Furthermore, we had all tacitly assumed that Mark was a confirmed bachelor. Jill, ever the pessimist, confidently predicts that the union will inevitably end in tears. While Jill's cynicism is well-documented, I suspect there is a modicum of truth in her assessment. Apparently, there are already indications of discord. Rose envisions a lavish wedding with all the customary accoutrements, whereas Mark apparently favors a clandestine ceremony on a remote beach. We shall have to wait and see how this plays out!

Duty calls, I must depart lest I incur the wrath of my employer. Do write back soon and apprise me of your progress at college. I eagerly anticipate Easter, when you will be home for the holidays and we can catch up properly.

With much love,

Jenny

mock_data.translation:
25/5/02

Hurmatli Key,

Men buni ishga borishdan oldin shoshilinch yozyapman. Senga ajoyib yangiliklarni aytishni kuta olmadim. Kim hozirgina unashtirilganini hech qachon taxmin qila olmaysan! Rouz Barns va Mark Uilson! Mana, ishonchim komilki, bu seni hayratda qoldirdi!

Biz bu haqda kecha kechqurun Rouzning tug'ilgan kuni ziyofatida eshitdik. Bu juda ajoyib ziyofat edi, ko'plab taomlar va ichimliklar hamda ajoyib musiqa bilan. Biz hammamiz ajoyib vaqt o'tkazayotgan edik, qachonki Mark to'satdan o'rnidan turdi va gapira boshladi. Hammani gapirishni to'xtatish va unga quloq solishga majbur qilish uchun unga biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi, lekin u Rouzni halol ayol qilishga qaror qilganini va kecha kechqurun unga turmush qurishni taklif qilganini e'lon qildi. U Rouz uni xotini bo'lishga rozi bo'lish orqali qanchalik baxtli qilgani haqida ko'proq gapirdi va u qanchalik ajoyib ekani haqida she'riy tilda maqtadi. Bu vaqtga kelib, deyarli hech kim eshitmayotgan edi. Ko'pchiligimiz hayratda qoldik.

Men ular hatto do'st ekanliklarini ham bilmas edim, chunki men ularning ikkalasini ham tez-tez ko'rmayman. Pam kechagi tajribadan foydalanib, Rouz va Mark o'rtasida nimadir bo'layotganini tushunishi kerak edi, dedi, chunki oxirgi haftalarda ular bir-biridan ajralib yurmaganga o'xshagan. Biroq, ular va Pam bir xil firmada ishlaydilar va u biznes ularni tez-tez birlashtirmoqda deb o'yladi.

Bilasizmi, Rouz va Mark bir-biriga mutlaqo mos kelmaydilar va ular turmush qurishlari g'oyasi imkonsiz ko'rinadi. Bundan tashqari, biz hammamiz Mark qat'iy bakalavr deb o'ylagandik. Jill hammasi ko'z yoshlari bilan tugashiga ishonchi komil ekanligini aytadi. Albatta, u taniqli kinik, lekin menimcha, uning so'zlarida biroz haqiqat bor. Ko'rinib turibdiki, allaqachon muammo belgilari bor. Rouz barcha bezaklari bilan katta to'y xohlaydi. Mark ular chet elga borib, qayerdadir plyajda jimgina turmush qurishlarini xohlaydi. Kuzatishda qoling!

Endi ketishim kerak, aks holda ishga kechikaman. Tez orada yoz va kollejda qanday ekanligingni menga xabar ber. Men Pasxa bayramini kutmoqdaman, o'shanda bayramlar uchun uyga qaytasan va biz yaxshi suhbatlashamiz.

Katta muhabbat bilan,
Jenni

mock_data.translationB1:
Qadrli Kay,

Ishga ketishdan oldin tezda yozayapman. Sizga aytadigan ba'zi ajoyib yangiliklar bor! Kim turmush qurayotganiga ishonmaysiz! Rouz Barns va Mark Uilson! O'ylaymanki, bu sizni hayratda qoldiradi!

Bu haqda kecha Rouzning tug'ilgan kunida eshitdik. U yerda ko'p ovqat, ichimlik va yaxshi musiqa bor edi. Hammasi ajoyib edi. Mark o'rnidan turib gapira boshlaganida, hammamiz yaxshi vaqt o'tkazayotgan edik. U hammaga gapirishni to'xtatib, tinglashga majbur qilish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi. Keyin, u Rouzdan unga turmushga chiqishni so'raganini aytdi. U Rouzning "ha" deb javob berishi uni juda xursand qilganini aytdi. U, shuningdek, uning qanchalik ajoyib ekanligini ham aytdi. Ko'pchiligimiz juda hayratda qoldik.

Men ularning do'st ekanligini ham bilmas edim, chunki men ularni juda kam ko'raman. Pem Rouz va Mark o'rtasida bir narsa bo'layotganini ko'rishi kerak edi, deb aytdi. U ularning yaqinda doim birga bo'lganini aytdi. Ammo ular va Pem bir xil kompaniyada ishlaydi, shuning uchun u bu ish bilan bog'liq deb o'yladi.

Rouz va Mark juda boshqa odamlar, shuning uchun ularning turmush qurishi g'alati tuyuladi. Shuningdek, hammamiz Mark turmush qurishni xohlamaydi, deb o'ylagandik. Jillning aytishicha, u buning yomon tugashiga ishonadi. U ko'pincha salbiy, lekin men u haqli bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylayman. Go'yo allaqachon muammolar bor. Rouz hamma narsasi bilan katta to'y qilishni xohlaydi. Mark boshqa mamlakatga borib, plyajda tinchgina turmush qurishni xohlaydi. Kutib ko'ramiz!

Men hozir ketishim kerak, aks holda ishga kechikaman. Tez orada menga xat yozing va kollej haqida gapiring. Sizni Pasxa bayrami uchun uyga kelganingizda intizorlik bilan kutaman va biz gaplashamiz.

Ko'p muhabbat bilan,

Jenni
